title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-031
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA records, media logs, and press releases regarding the JAL 1628 UFO sighting in Alaska, including internal correspondence and summaries of the investigation.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 cargo jet crew reported unidentified lights accompanying their aircraft over Alaska.
incidents.quote: The JAL Captain requested a change in altitude-from 350 to 310; and also performed a 360 degree turn
incidents.size: as big as B747 or larger

incidents.summary: JAL Captain Terauchi reported a second sighting of unidentified lights while flying over Alaska.
incidents.quote: His statement to the controller was 'irregular lights, looks like a spaceship,'
